project: PAUSE Mobile Expo App - Category 3D Artwork Remake & UI Framing

user_requests: falli piu saturi, devono essere belli colorati
nella categoria animali sempe un bassotto
final_user_revision.implemented_direction: Simple matte 3D objects with saturated lively colors, without neon glow or busy scenery. Animali is a long-bodied short-legged dachshund, never a fox. Family colorful-3d-v3; quiet neutral tile framing.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow this art direction and framing specification strictly for regenerating the 3D category artwork set from scratch and integrating it cleanly into the PAUSE Home and Topic Picker.
Do not perform a general redesign of the app. Only update category artwork assets, artwork manifests, and minimal styling tweaks on CategoryArtwork, HomeCategoryTile, and CategoryGrid.

Preserve 3D tactile character (matte porcelain / frosted glass / soft studio clay) while stripping out noisy neon light spills, hyper-saturated multi-colored glows, complex miniature dioramas, and competing high-contrast backgrounds.
Ensure each category has exactly ONE single iconic, centered hero subject instantly legible at 32px-48px size inside a ~68px tile.
All interactive elements and test IDs must be preserved. Ensure testID convention is retained.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Avoid neon candy gloss, radioactive rim lighting, noisy volumetric fog, and microscopic clutter. Prioritize monolithic sculptural clarity, calm matte textures, and tonal consistency.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.visual_hierarchy: In Home, the carousel story card is the protagonist. Category tiles must be calm secondary navigational anchors, not competing neon billboards.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast_and_accessibility: Tile labels must maintain WCAG AA contrast against the card surface. The image subject must sit in the upper half/center with subtle vignette fading into the tile background to never obscure category text.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.test_attributes: Keep all data-testid and testID props intact on tiles, images, fallback icons, and badges.

design_problem_analysis.user_feedback: User stated: 'ora partendo da queste, rendile meno sgargianti ed un po' piu semplici, meno d impatto nella home. ma comuqnue cosi' and 'no, rifalle da zero che stiano meglio nella home, non so come spiegarti, queste rubano troppo l attenzione'.
design_problem_analysis.root_cause: Existing illustrations have hyper-saturated colors, intense contrasting glows, high-detail multi-element dioramas, and stark lighting contrast that clash with and pull focus away from the main story carousel cards in Home.
design_problem_analysis.required_solution: Remake the 12 categories + 1 'all' banner from scratch as cohesive 3D objects with unified lighting, soft architectural studio environment, muted refined palette, single recognizable iconic focal point per tile, and softened card surface framing.

art_direction_and_3d_style.aesthetic_philosophy: Sculptural Tactile Minimalism (Dieter Rams meets modern Scandinavian 3D product rendering)

materials_and_surfaces.primary_material: Matte soft-touch ceramic / fine-grain bisque porcelain (specular roughness 0.65 - 0.75)
materials_and_surfaces.secondary_accent: Frosted satin glass / translucent smoked quartz (translucency 35%, subtle inner diffusion, no harsh caustics)
materials_and_surfaces.accent_metal: Brushed warm titanium or matte anodized aluminium for delicate connecting elements

lighting_and_atmosphere.key_light: Diffused softbox from top-left (45 degrees, warm white 4800K, softness 0.8)
lighting_and_atmosphere.fill_light: Low-intensity bounce from bottom-right (cool ambient tint, 15% intensity)
lighting_and_atmosphere.rim_light: Subtle 1px micro-rim edge separation only; strictly NO neon rainbow halo or blinding backlights
lighting_and_atmosphere.shadows: Very soft ambient occlusion underneath the base; no harsh cast drop shadows
lighting_and_atmosphere.background_environment: Deep neutral obsidian dark slate (#080B14 to #0D111D) vignette seamlessly blending into app surface token colors.artworkSurface (#05070C)

color_palette_tuning.saturation_cap: Muted to 40% - 55% max saturation. Tones should be sophisticated mineral / botanical shades rather than saturated neon primaries.

ui_framing_and_home_integration_adjustme.goal: Dramatically lower visual noise in Home without changing structural layout or breaking 3-column topic grid

tile_container.border_color_default: colors.glassBorder (change from glassBorderStrong to soften outline)

image_containment.compact_image_scale: left: '10%', width: '80%', top: 2 (centers the artwork with comfortable negative space margin)
image_containment.gradient_vignette: Ensure bottom gradient overlay has [0, 0.40, 0.78, 1] locations fading to colors.artworkSurface so the lower half of the tile remains dark and peaceful for the text label

asset_generation_pipeline.recommended_method: Generate individual 512x512 square assets (PNG/JPEG) with consistent dark slate background (#080B14) or contact sheet grid for unified lighting coherence.
asset_generation_pipeline.compression_and_delivery: Compress to WebP or progressive JPEG (~30KB-50KB each). Update category_art_sources_v3.json and reference in category-artwork.tsx under ART_VERSION = 'glass-2026-10-v3'.
asset_generation_pipeline.fallback_protection: Preserve existing CategoryIcon SVG line family as automatic instant fallback during image load or offline network conditions.
